exposure: number of providers present during labor and delivery
cohort: The study included 763 mothers who gave birth at public hospitals in the South Gondar zone, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: The mean person-centered maternity care (PCMC) score was low, and factors significantly associated with PCMC included rural residence, 3-4 providers present during labor and delivery, no history of facility delivery, two days length of hospital stay, and highest wealth.
